stats.power: How hard your attacks hit once correct answers have charged your weapon.
stats.defense: Cuts the damage you take from each boss hit (about 3% per point, capped at 60%).
stats.focus: How much charge each correct answer gives your weapon, and how fast your dash recovers.
stats.luck: Critical-hit chance: 1% per point, capped at 15%. Never changes coins, drops or prices.

effectTypes.streak_damage: +value% damage per consecutive correct answer (stacks up to 5).
effectTypes.first_strike: The first correct answer of a fight deals +value% damage.
effectTypes.shield_on_correct: Gain a value-HP shield after each correct answer.
effectTypes.second_chance: Once per fight, a wrong answer becomes a miss with no damage taken.
effectTypes.heal_on_streak: Heal value HP after 3 correct answers in a row.
effectTypes.thorns: Reflect value% of damage taken back to the boss.
effectTypes.coin_bonus: +value% coins from quests (all sources combined cap at 25%).
effectTypes.hint: Once per fight, remove value wrong answer(s) from a question.
effectTypes.dodge: value% chance to dodge a boss attack automatically.
effectTypes.low_hp_power: +value% damage while below 30% HP. Reserved: not used in v1 because it rewards fighting on when nearly wiped out, the in-game version of revenge trading.
effectTypes.steady: Your damage can't vary: no crits and no glancing blows. Value is unused (0).
effectTypes.damage_reduction: Take value% less damage from every source.
effectTypes.damage_cap: No single boss hit can take more than value% of your max HP.
effectTypes.buffer_hp: Start each fight with a value-HP buffer bar that soaks damage before your HP. It does not refill during the fight.
effectTypes.telegraph: Boss attack wind-ups become visible value seconds earlier.
effectTypes.start_charge: Start each fight with value% weapon charge.
effectTypes.periodic_double: Every value seconds of a fight, your next hit deals double damage.
effectTypes.mix_bonus: +value to every stat if your 4 armor pieces come from at least 3 different sets.
effectTypes.charge_hold: Your weapon charge never fades while you wait. Value is unused (0).
effectTypes.hp_cost: Lose value% of your max HP at the start of each fight (a fee or premium you pay up front).
effectTypes.damage_dealt_mod: Change all damage you deal by value% (negative values are a tradeoff).
effectTypes.discount_window: For 3 seconds after the boss lands a big attack, your hits deal +value% damage.
effectTypes.review_queue: After the fight, up to value missed questions are added to your spaced-review queue.
effectTypes.damage_over_time: Your hits deal an extra value% of their damage spread over the next 5 seconds.
effectTypes.last_stand: Once per fight, a hit that would knock you out leaves you at value HP instead.
effectTypes.buff_extend: Once per fight, extend one timed effect by value seconds.

effectNotes: Any effect may carry an optional "duration" in seconds; without it the effect lasts the whole fight.
Effects of the same type from different items add together, except once-per-fight effects (second_chance, hint, last_stand, buff_extend), where each item grants its own single use.
Rule for designers: within the same world and slot, no two items share an effect type.

sets.name: Rookie Threads
sets.theme: The hoodie-and-sneakers outfit every new player starts in. Comfy, not armored.
sets.lesson: Everyone starts somewhere; the first step is showing up and learning the basics.

bonuses.text: Rookie Tip: once per fight, Hoot crosses out one wrong answer for you.

effects.text: Once per fight, remove 1 wrong answer from a question.

bonuses.text: First-Day Nerves Gone: +1 focus.

sets.name: Penny's Rainy-Day Gear
sets.theme: A bright yellow raincoat kit stitched by Penny the piggy bank. Built for storms you did not schedule.
sets.lesson: An emergency fund of 3-6 months of expenses absorbs life's surprise hits so they don't turn into debt.

bonuses.text: Cushion: +2 defense.
Rainy-Day Fund: once per fight, a wrong answer costs you nothing. The fund refills between fights, not during them.

effects.text: Once per fight, a wrong answer becomes a miss with no damage taken.

sets.name: Snowball Knight
sets.theme: Icy white-and-gold plate that gets stronger the longer you keep rolling. Chip insists it is 'very aerodynamic'.
sets.lesson: Compounding: returns earn their own returns, so a streak of small gains snowballs, and starting early matters most.

bonuses.text: Momentum: +2 power.
Interest on Interest: every correct answer in a row adds +8% damage, up to 5 stacks. A wrong answer melts the snowball.

effects.text: +8% damage per consecutive correct answer (up to 5 stacks).

sets.name: Budget Ranger
sets.theme: Light forest-green leathers with a pocket for every dollar. Fast, planned, never caught flat-footed.
sets.lesson: A 50/30/20 budget that pays yourself first gives every dollar a job before it can wander off.

bonuses.text: Planned Ahead: +2 focus.
Every Dollar Has a Job: surprise attacks find nothing to hit. 10% chance to dodge, and your dash recharges 20% faster.

effects.text: 10% chance to dodge a boss attack.
Dash recharges 20% faster.

sets.name: Basket Weaver
sets.theme: Patchwork wicker armor woven from many different materials. No single weak spot, no single strong one.
sets.lesson: Diversification: owning many things that don't move together reduces the damage any one of them can do.

bonuses.text: Spread Out: +1 defense, +1 luck.
Many Baskets: take 10% less damage from every source.

effects.text: Take 10% less damage from every source.

sets.name: Value Vanguard
sets.theme: Deep purple plate with silver trim, forged for knights who only charge when the price is right.
sets.lesson: Buy with a margin of safety: when Mr. Market panics, good companies go on sale below their intrinsic value.

bonuses.text: Room to Be Wrong: +3 defense.
Buy the Panic: right after the boss lands one of its big attacks, you get a 3-second Discount Window where your hits deal +30% damage.

effects.text: For 3 seconds after a big boss attack, deal +30% damage.

sets.name: Stop-Loss Sentinel
sets.theme: Crimson-and-charcoal guard armor with a built-in tripwire. Grizz's favorite outfit, obviously.
sets.lesson: Decide your exit and size your position before you enter, so one bad trade can never sink the account.

bonuses.text: Pre-Planned Exit: +3 focus.
Stop Triggered: no single hit can take more than 20% of your max HP. Like a stop order, it caps each loss; it does not stop you losing several in a row.

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 20% of your max HP.

sets.name: Day Trader
sets.theme: Neon-and-black speed gear covered in tiny price tickers. Hits hard, fast and often. Leaks HP on every trade.
sets.lesson: Fast, frequent trading raises both your wins and your losses, and the fees and spreads come out every single time.

bonuses.text: Hot Hand: +2 power, +1 luck, -1 defense.
All Gas: critical hits deal +40% damage, but you pay 5% of your max HP at the start of every fight in fees.

effects.text: Critical hits deal +40% damage.
Lose 5% of max HP at the start of each fight (fees and spreads).

sets.name: Covered Caller
sets.theme: Teal-and-cream robes of a steady income collector. Never the flashiest hit in the arena, never broke either.
sets.lesson: Selling covered calls earns steady premium income but caps your upside if the stock rockets.

bonuses.text: Collect the Premium: +4 focus.
Premium Income: every correct answer pays a 4-HP shield, but your damage is locked steady: no crits, ever. Capped upside, reliable income.

effects.text: Gain a 4-HP shield after each correct answer.
Damage can't vary: no crits and no glancing blows.

sets.name: Protective Put
sets.theme: Navy insurance-adjuster plate with orange expiry stamps on every piece. Coverage is excellent. Until it isn't.
sets.lesson: A protective put is insurance: you pay a premium up front, it caps your losses, and it expires.

bonuses.text: Coverage: +4 defense.
Bought Protection: pay 5% of your max HP at the start of each fight (the premium). For the next 30 seconds, no single hit can take more than 10% of your max HP. Then the policy expires.

effects.text: Lose 5% of max HP at the start of each fight (the premium).
For the first 30 seconds, no single hit can take more than 10% of your max HP.

sets.name: Micro Manager
sets.theme: Sleek black flight suit with neon-green tick marks. Built for traders who size small and stay in the game.
sets.lesson: Micro futures are one-tenth the size of the E-minis, so you can size positions properly instead of betting the account.

bonuses.text: Right-Sized: +5 focus.
Stay in the Game: once per fight, a knockout leaves you standing at 1 HP.

effects.text: Once per fight, a knockout leaves you at 1 HP instead.

sets.name: Hedger's Harness
sets.theme: Wheat-gold workwear from the muddy trading pits of old Chicago. Unglamorous. Unbothered.
sets.lesson: Hedging with futures shrinks your risk and your upside at the same time: you trade spectacular for steady.

bonuses.text: Locked-In Price: +5 defense.
Fully Hedged: take 30% less damage and deal 15% less damage. Steady beats spectacular.

effects.text: Take 30% less damage from every source.
Deal 15% less damage.

items.name: Rookie Cap
items.unlock: starter: every player owns it from signup
items.lesson: Showing up to learn is the first deposit in your knowledge account.
items.flavor: Brim forward. Brim backward. Brim sideways if you're feeling bold.

items.name: Rookie Hoodie
items.unlock: starter: every player owns it from signup
items.lesson: You don't need fancy gear to start investing; you need the basics and a little time.
items.flavor: The pocket holds snacks, not spare cash. Yet.

items.name: Rookie Joggers
items.unlock: starter: every player owns it from signup
items.lesson: Every financial journey starts with comfortable first steps.
items.flavor: Rated for running, lounging and running late.

items.name: Rookie Sneakers
items.unlock: starter: every player owns it from signup
items.lesson: Small steps taken consistently beat big steps taken once.
items.flavor: Squeak on every polished floor. Hoot finds this distracting.

items.name: Rainy-Day Hood

effects.text: Boss wind-ups show 0.2 seconds earlier. You can see the storm coming.

items.lesson: Keep emergency money somewhere safe and easy to reach, like a high-yield savings account.
items.flavor: Penny says it's not paranoia if it actually rains.

items.name: Emergency Fund Chestplate

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 25% of your max HP.

items.lesson: Three to six months of expenses set aside turns a crisis into an inconvenience, even though that cash earns less than investments.
items.flavor: Dented by a surprise car repair. Still standing. That's the point.

items.name: Safety-Net Leggings

effects.text: Start each fight with an 8-HP insured buffer.

items.lesson: FDIC insurance protects bank deposits up to $250,000 per depositor, per bank, per ownership category.
items.flavor: Woven from genuine government-backed mesh. Up to the limit.

items.name: Puddle-Proof Boots

effects.text: 5% chance to sidestep a boss attack.

items.lesson: Avoiding overdraft fees is money you get to keep.
items.flavor: Stomp through puddles. Do not stomp through your checking balance.

items.name: Snowball Helm

effects.text: Heal 4 HP after 3 correct answers in a row.

items.lesson: Compound interest means you earn interest on your interest, not just on what you put in.
items.flavor: Slightly cold. Warms up as your returns pile up.

items.name: Compound Cuirass

effects.text: Gain a 2-HP shield after every correct answer. Small, but it keeps stacking.

items.lesson: Compounding is slow at first and powerful later; you trade fast thrills for steady growth.
items.flavor: Each layer was added on top of the last one. Chip calls this 'layer-on-layer action'.

items.name: Rule-of-72 Greaves

effects.text: Every 72 seconds, your next hit deals double damage.

items.lesson: Divide 72 by an annual return to estimate how many years it takes your money to double.
items.flavor: 72 rivets. Hoot counted. Twice.

items.name: Head-Start Sabatons

effects.text: Start every fight with your weapon 25% charged.

items.lesson: Starting to invest at 17 instead of 30 can beat investing far more money later, because time does the heavy lifting.
items.flavor: Come pre-broken-in. Your future self says thanks.

items.name: Ranger's Planning Cap

effects.text: +3 seconds on hard questions.

items.lesson: A budget is a plan for your money made before the month starts, not a guilt trip after it ends.
items.flavor: Has a tiny pencil tucked behind the ear flap.

items.name: 50/30/20 Tunic

effects.text: +5% coins from quests.

items.lesson: The 50/30/20 rule: about half your take-home pay to needs, 30% to wants, 20% to savings and debt payoff.
items.flavor: Three pockets, sized exactly 50, 30 and 20. Snacks go in the 30.

items.name: Pay-Yourself-First Pants

effects.text: Your first correct answer of each fight deals +15% damage.

items.lesson: Move savings out on payday, automatically, before you have a chance to spend it.
items.flavor: The savings pocket zips shut before the spending pocket even opens.

items.name: Envelope Boots

effects.text: Dash recharges 10% faster.

items.lesson: Envelope budgeting: when a category's money is gone, it's gone until next month.
items.flavor: Each boot holds one envelope. Labeled. Bolt approves.

items.name: Wicker Helm

effects.text: Take 2% less damage from every source.

items.unlock: shop (World 1, after finishing 'Meet the Asset Classes')
items.lesson: Stocks, bonds, cash and real estate each behave differently, which is exactly why you'd own more than one.
items.flavor: Woven from four different reeds. None of them panic at the same time.

items.name: Many-Baskets Jerkin

effects.text: Take 3% less damage from every source.

items.lesson: Diversification lowers the swings of the whole portfolio without needing to give up much return.
items.flavor: Twelve little baskets sewn on. One egg each. Hoot did the math.

items.name: Patchwork Trousers

effects.text: Take 2% less damage from every source.

items.lesson: Rebalancing means trimming what grew and topping up what shrank, so your mix stays the way you planned.
items.flavor: Every patch is a different fabric. The tailor called it 'rebalanced'.

items.name: Nest-Egg Boots

effects.text: Take 2% less damage from every source.

items.unlock: shop (World 1, after finishing 'Meet the Asset Classes')
items.lesson: A nest egg built from many sources is harder to crack than one built on a single bet.
items.flavor: Padded with straw. Smell faintly of farm. Very stable.

items.name: Intrinsic Visor

effects.text: Once per fight, remove 1 wrong answer. See through the price to the value.

items.lesson: Intrinsic value is what a business is worth based on the cash it will produce, which can differ wildly from today's price.
items.flavor: Filters out ticker noise. Lets the cash flows through.

items.name: Margin-of-Safety Plate

effects.text: Start each fight with a 20-HP buffer. Room to be wrong.

items.unlock: boss drop: boss-w2-mr-market (guaranteed on first win)
items.lesson: Buying well below your value estimate leaves room for your estimate to be wrong.
items.flavor: Twice as thick as it needs to be. That's the whole idea.

items.name: Moat Tassets

effects.text: Reflect 10% of damage taken back at the boss.

items.lesson: An economic moat, like a strong brand or network effect, makes it painful for competitors to attack a company's profits.
items.flavor: Comes with a tiny decorative drawbridge. Non-functional. Very cute.

items.name: Patient Loafers

effects.text: +4 seconds on hard questions.

items.lesson: Mr. Market offers a new price every day; you're allowed to ignore him until the price is right.
items.flavor: Designed for standing still for very long periods. Surprisingly comfy.

items.name: Sentinel Sallet

effects.text: Boss wind-ups show 0.2 seconds earlier.

items.lesson: Know where you'll get out before you get in.
items.flavor: The visor has a red line painted at exactly 2%. Grizz insisted.

items.name: Position-Size Brigandine

effects.text: Take 15% less damage.
Deal 10% less damage.

items.lesson: Position size = dollars you're willing to lose divided by the distance to your stop; smaller size shrinks gains and losses alike.
items.flavor: Made of many small plates instead of one big one. Fewer ways to lose it all.

items.name: Two-Percent Greaves

effects.text: Gain a 3-HP shield after every correct answer.

items.lesson: Risking 1-2% of your account per trade means a losing streak stings but doesn't end you.
items.flavor: You could lose ten fights in a row in these and still walk home.

items.name: Trailing-Stop Treads

effects.text: Heal 5 HP after 3 correct answers in a row. Lock in your gains.

items.lesson: A trailing stop moves up as price rises, locking in gains while giving a winner room to run.
items.flavor: They follow you everywhere. In a helpful way.

items.name: Day-Trader Visor

effects.text: Your first correct answer each fight deals +25% damage.
Lose 2% of max HP at the start of each fight (commissions).

items.unlock: shop (World 2, after finishing 'Day, Swing, Position or Invest?')
items.lesson: Most day traders lose money over time; speed amplifies results in both directions and costs add up.
items.flavor: Six screens projected onto one visor. Blinking is discouraged.

items.name: Scalper's Jacket

effects.text: 8% chance to dodge a boss attack.
Lose 2% of max HP at the start of each fight (spreads).

items.unlock: shop (World 2, after finishing 'Day, Swing, Position or Invest?')
items.lesson: Scalpers chase tiny moves many times a day, so the bid-ask spread is a cost they pay over and over.
items.flavor: Forty-two pockets. All of them have receipts for fees.

items.name: Momentum Shorts

effects.text: +5% damage per consecutive correct answer (up to 5 stacks).
Lose 2% of max HP at the start of each fight (slippage).

items.unlock: shop (World 2, after finishing 'Trends: Stairs Up, Stairs Down')
items.lesson: Momentum can carry a price further than expected, and reverses just as suddenly.
items.flavor: Built for going fast in one direction. Turning is a separate purchase.

items.name: Fast-Fill Sneakers

effects.text: Dash recharges 20% faster.
Lose 2% of max HP at the start of each fight (fees).

items.unlock: shop (World 2, after finishing 'Order Types: Telling Your Broker Exactly What You Want')
items.lesson: A market order fills fast but at whatever price is available; speed has a price called slippage.
items.flavor: Zero to sixty. Sixty back to zero. Also fast.

items.name: Strike-Price Circlet

effects.text: Your first correct answer each fight deals +20% damage.

items.lesson: The strike price is the price at which an option lets its owner buy or sell the stock.
items.flavor: Engraved with a number you agreed to. Hope you meant it.

items.name: Covered-Call Coat

effects.text: Heal 6 HP after 3 correct answers in a row.

items.lesson: Owning 100 shares and selling a call against them is 'renting out' your shares for premium income.
items.flavor: Very warm. Pockets full of small premiums. No room for a rocket.

items.name: Income Leggings

effects.text: +5% coins from quests.

items.lesson: Option premium is income you keep whether or not the option gets exercised.
items.flavor: Every step jingles a little. That's the premium.

items.name: Wheel Boots

effects.text: 8% chance to spin out of a boss attack.

items.lesson: The wheel: sell cash-secured puts until assigned, then sell covered calls until called away, and repeat.
items.flavor: Round and round. Profitable, mostly. Dizzying, always.

items.name: Insurance Helm

effects.text: Lose 3% of max HP at the start of each fight (the premium).
Take 8% less damage.

items.lesson: A put option gives you the right to sell at the strike, putting a floor under your losses for a price.
items.flavor: The fine print is printed on the inside. Read it before the fight.

items.name: Policyholder Plate

effects.text: Once per fight, a wrong answer becomes a miss. Your policy pays one claim.

items.unlock: boss drop: boss-w3-theta-reaper (guaranteed on first win)
items.lesson: Insurance always costs something; the question is whether the protection is worth the premium.
items.flavor: Pried from the Theta Reaper's hourglass. Still ticking faintly.

items.name: Strike-Guard Greaves

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 20% of your max HP.

items.lesson: A put struck closer to the current price protects more and costs more; a farther strike is cheaper but leaves a bigger gap.
items.flavor: Adjustable height. Higher protection, higher price tag.

items.name: Expiry Boots

effects.text: +5 seconds on hard questions.

items.lesson: Options expire; time decay (theta) eats a little of their value every single day.
items.flavor: Stamped with a date. Walk fast.

items.name: Tick-Size Helmet

effects.text: Gain a 3-HP shield after every correct answer.

items.lesson: One tick on the Micro E-mini S&P (MES) is worth $1.25; on the full E-mini (ES) it's $12.50.
items.flavor: The HUD shows your P&L in ticks and dollars. Mostly dollars. Gulp.

items.name: Micro-Contract Mail

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 15% of your max HP.

items.lesson: Micros let a small account trade index futures at one-tenth the size, so one bad day isn't the last day.
items.flavor: Ten tiny rings where one big ring used to be. Flexibility is the flex.

items.name: Mark-to-Market Leggings

effects.text: Heal 8 HP after 3 correct answers in a row. Settled daily.

items.lesson: Futures gains and losses settle in cash every day, so losses hit your account before you ever 'sell'.
items.flavor: Tallies the score every night whether you like it or not.

items.name: Right-Size Boots

effects.text: Take 8% less damage.

items.lesson: Size so a normal bad day costs a small, planned slice of your account.
items.flavor: Not too big. Not too small. Goldilocks would trade micros.

items.name: Farmer's Wide-Brim

effects.text: Boss wind-ups show 0.3 seconds earlier. Farmers watch the sky.

items.lesson: Hedgers, like farmers and airlines, use futures to lock in prices, not to gamble on them.
items.flavor: Keeps off sun, rain and the occasional flying soybean.

items.name: Hedger's Vest

effects.text: Reflect 20% of damage taken back at the boss. When you lose, your hedge gains.

items.unlock: boss drop: boss-w4-margin-caller (guaranteed on first win)
items.lesson: A short index-futures hedge gains when your stock portfolio loses, and gives up gains when it rises.
items.flavor: Taken from the Margin Caller's coat rack. He didn't call ahead either.

items.name: Basis Breeches

effects.text: 6% chance to dodge a boss attack.

items.lesson: Basis is the gap between the futures price and the index; it shrinks to zero at expiration.
items.flavor: Two legs, slightly different lengths, that end up the same length by the end of the month.

items.name: Muddy Chicago Boots

effects.text: +4 seconds on hard questions.

items.lesson: Futures began in 1800s Chicago so grain farmers and buyers could agree on prices before harvest.
items.flavor: The mud is historical. Please don't clean it.

items.name: Trusty Calculator
items.unlock: starter: every player owns it from signup
items.lesson: Doing the math yourself is the most underrated money skill there is.
items.flavor: Solar powered. Slightly sticky 7 key.

items.name: Budget Blade

effects.text: Once per fight, cut 1 wrong answer from a question. Trim the waste.

items.lesson: Cutting spending you don't value frees money for things you do.
items.flavor: Cuts expenses. Also slimes.

items.name: Compound Crossbow

effects.text: +5% damage per consecutive correct answer (up to 5 stacks).

items.unlock: shop (World 1, after finishing 'Compounding: The Head-Start Superpower')
items.lesson: Compounding rewards whoever leaves their money invested the longest without interruption.
items.flavor: Patience loaded. Aim required.

items.name: Penny's Piggy Mallet

effects.text: Critical hits deal +25% damage.

items.unlock: boss drop: boss-w1-inflato (guaranteed on first win)
items.lesson: Saved money beats inflation only when it's put to work earning more than prices rise.
items.flavor: Penny swears no piggy banks were harmed. It is, technically, a piggy bank.

items.name: Bull-Horn Lance

effects.text: Critical hits deal +20% damage.

items.lesson: Bull markets reward conviction, but even strong trends end; ride them with a plan for the reversal.
items.flavor: Chip's horns, polished and pointy. He wants them back by Friday.

items.name: Moving-Average Bow

effects.text: Damage can't vary: no crits and no glancing blows. Smooth, a little slow.

items.unlock: shop (World 2, after finishing 'Moving Averages: Smoothing the Noise')
items.lesson: Moving averages smooth out noise but always lag behind the price.
items.flavor: Always a little late. Never flustered.

items.name: Delta Daggers

effects.text: +6% damage per consecutive correct answer (up to 5 stacks). The faster you go, the faster you speed up.

items.lesson: Delta measures how much an option moves per $1 move in the stock; gamma measures how fast delta itself changes.
items.flavor: Two blades. Twice the Greek.

items.name: Theta Scythe

effects.text: Hits deal an extra 20% of their damage over the next 5 seconds.

items.lesson: Time decay works against option buyers and for option sellers, a little every day.
items.flavor: Tick. Tock. Ouch.

items.name: Tick-Value Trident

effects.text: Your first correct answer each fight deals +25% damage.

items.lesson: Every futures contract has a fixed dollar value per tick, so you can know your risk before you enter.
items.flavor: Three prongs: ES, NQ, YM. Micros sold separately. (Kidding. Same shop.)

items.name: Mark-to-Market Maul

effects.text: Critical hits deal +30% damage.

items.lesson: Futures accounts settle daily: gains and losses are added or taken in cash at each day's close.
items.flavor: Settles all debts. Daily.

items.name: Piggy-Bank Buckler

effects.text: Take 4% less damage.

items.lesson: A savings account is your first shield: boring, safe and always there.
items.flavor: Coin slot doubles as a peephole.

items.name: Ledger Lantern

effects.text: Boss wind-ups show 0.3 seconds earlier.

items.lesson: Tracking your spending shows where your money is going before it's gone.
items.flavor: Fueled by receipts. Smells faintly of coffee you didn't need.

items.name: Moat Shield

effects.text: Take 8% less damage.

items.lesson: Companies with wide moats can fend off competitors and keep earning high returns for years.
items.flavor: There's a small moat around the rim. A tiny fish lives there. His name is Warren.

items.name: Trading Journal Tome

effects.text: After each fight, up to 5 missed questions go into your review queue.
+10% XP from battles.

items.unlock: shop (World 2, after finishing 'Journal, Backtest, Paper Trade')
items.lesson: Traders who journal every trade learn from their mistakes instead of repeating them.
items.flavor: Page one: 'Note to self: stop doing that.'

items.name: Spread Shield

effects.text: No single boss hit can take more than 15% of your max HP.
Deal 10% less damage.

items.lesson: A vertical spread caps both your maximum loss and your maximum gain.
items.flavor: Two layers, bolted together at the strikes.

items.name: Margin-Buffer Tower Shield

effects.text: Start each fight with a 20-HP margin buffer.

items.lesson: Keeping cash well above maintenance margin is what stops a normal dip from becoming a margin call.
items.flavor: Heavy, tall and extremely unexciting. Exactly like good risk management.

items.name: Correlation Charm

effects.text: +2 to every stat if your 4 armor pieces come from at least 3 different sets.

items.lesson: Diversification works best when your holdings don't all move together (low correlation).
items.flavor: Four tiny charms that never agree on anything. Perfect.

items.name: Patience Charm

effects.text: Your weapon charge never fades while you wait for an opening.

items.unlock: shop (World 1, after finishing 'Dollar-Cost Averaging and Staying Put')
items.lesson: Time in the market beats timing the market; steady automatic investing keeps you in the game.
items.flavor: Does nothing quickly. On purpose.

items.name: Index Autopilot Amulet

effects.text: Damage can't vary: no crits and no glancing blows. You get the market's return, every time.

items.unlock: shop (World 1, after finishing 'The Index Fund Income Engine')
items.lesson: An index fund gives you the whole market's return at a tiny cost, instead of betting on picking winners.
items.flavor: Bolt built it. It has exactly one setting.

items.name: Fee-Free Feather

effects.text: +5% coins from quests. Fewer leaks, more kept.

items.unlock: shop (World 1, after finishing 'Funds, ETFs, and the Fee Leak')
items.lesson: A fund fee of 1% instead of 0.05% can quietly eat a big chunk of your money over decades.
items.flavor: Weighs nothing. Saves plenty.

items.name: Scam Radar Ring

effects.text: Once per fight, a wrong answer becomes a miss. The ring buzzed in time.

items.lesson: Guaranteed high returns, pressure to act now and secrecy are the classic red flags of a scam.
items.flavor: Buzzes whenever someone says 'guaranteed returns'. It buzzes a lot online.

items.name: Lucky Penny

effects.text: Critical hits deal +10% damage. Luck helps a little; it is not a plan.

items.lesson: Luck is real in markets over short periods, but skill and process are what you control.
items.flavor: Penny's cousin. Distant. Very shiny.

items.name: Mr. Market's Mood Ring

effects.text: 5% chance to dodge. You can read the boss's mood.

items.lesson: Market prices swing with fear and greed far more than the underlying businesses change.
items.flavor: Currently: euphoric. Check back in five minutes.

items.name: Greeks Monocle

effects.text: Boss wind-ups show 0.3 seconds earlier. You can see the acceleration.

items.unlock: shop (World 3, after finishing 'Vega, Rho & the Full Picture')
items.lesson: The Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega) tell you how an option's price will react to changes.
items.flavor: Hoot wears it ironically. Then unironically.

items.name: Contango Compass

effects.text: Once per fight, roll one timed effect forward by 15 seconds.

items.lesson: Rolling a futures position to the next contract can cost or earn money depending on the shape of the futures curve.
items.flavor: Always points to next month.

items.name: Grand Champion Crest

effects.text: +10% XP from battles.

items.lesson: Real financial confidence comes from understanding the whole system, from savings accounts to futures.
items.flavor: Earned, never bought. There's no price tag. Literally.
